title: S008 — Incremental derivation equivalence
description: S007 identified one dominant bottleneck: derive(canon, history) rebuilds the entire intervention chain on every call, making the prefix walk O(H^2). S008 asks whether Somnium can derive the same semantic world incrementally: can step(prevWorldState, I) extend a world by one intervention while producing exactly the same effective semantic world as the existing full-chain derivation? This is a semantic-equivalence experiment first; performance second.
constraints: Do not modify S007, P-007, P-005 or S006.
Do not create an independent semantic engine; P-007's one-representation principle (stateHash and WorldDiff from one canonical semantic representation) must be preserved.
If incremental derivation requires duplicating a semantic rule, document the duplication before proceeding.
S008 code stays under experiments/s008/ unless a separately justified source modification is absolutely required.
Do not sacrifice semantic correctness for performance.
A counterexample (semantic divergence) is a valid experimental result; do not patch around it silently.
design: derive remains the sole semantic authority. step(prev, I) appends I, reduces the accumulated chain by subsumption, and re-derives. reduceChain is order-preserving: legal writes keep last per (subject,predicate) cell; rejected writes keep first per contradiction id; negateEvent/forceEvent keep last per target; retractFact keeps first per fact id; severEdge/addEdge keep last per edge id.
acceptance_criteria: Differential equivalence over constructed + random + adversarial histories on verrin and ordos.

Adversarial matrix exercising every P-007 semantic dimension, constraints (AT_MOST_ONE/AT_LEAST_ONE), causal structure (grouped/disjunctive support, propagation, cycles), temporal behaviour (validity windows, PRECEDES cycles), and S007 convergence patterns.
Invalid-input equivalence: legacy rejects I iff incremental rejects I.
Branch isolation: stepping one branch never changes a sibling; no shared mutable state.
Determinism: repeated identical inputs give identical semantic state, stateHash and WorldDiff.
Performance: measure legacy vs incremental at H = 10..100000, both single final state and full prefix walk.
Regression: 624/624 tests, verify-facts 3/3, frozen hashes unchanged, src/ unchanged from 443d3d9.
result_summary: PASS. 1632/1632 differential cases pass. Reduced chain saturates (verrin 228, ordos 174) independent of H. Prefix walk is O(H) vs legacy O(H^2): 2.0x at H=1000, ~12x at H=10000, ~118x at H=100000. Caveats: the one-shot final derive is slower incrementally (the fold performs H steps), and the step is O(model) not O(1) (only the history scan is eliminated). One design defect was found and fixed during development (rejected-write contradiction id), recorded in self-harness/failures/20260910-233732-design-defect-s008-reduction-dropped-rejected-writes.json.
